additional_info.subject: ID0397846-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001196] Conveter error CRM:01811000550
additional_info.body:
Hello Marnic,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Sparki
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / PD 170001196
Charger ID/Serial No.:
oFsZJo
Problem Description:Converter error
After investigating the issue,we have determined that Converter [14] appears to be faulty. We also performed a converter swap test to confirm the issue, and the error persists with Converter[14], indicating that it is indeed the source of the problem.
To resolve this, we recommend replacing Converter [14]. Below is the MLFB number for your reference:
MLFB Number:
8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
-TB1, -TB2, ... -TB15 Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 18th April 2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
